# ShamiGo Windows v0.10.394: Optional remote VIEWER executable names.
# Optional portable/manual entries: one EXE basename per line; restart to reload.
# Example (remove leading # to enable):
# MyRemoteViewer.exe
# Do not add chrome.exe / msedge.exe / firefox.exe. Use the tray browser mode.
# Host-only services are not viewer windows and should not be added.
# NEW: You can designate a program from the ShamiGo tray menu or Settings.
# Personal assignments are saved to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ShamiGo\RemoteViewers.txt.
# Personal entries apply immediately and survive administrator installations.
